biography.value:
Rust dragons gnaw on the iron cubes of Acheron, endlessly drifting through that plane of eternal war. They eat metal, ruin weapons for sport, and serve as mercenaries to whichever army pays in iron. Their scales flake like corroded plate.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .cH74VGlERvCD3Lqq]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .4N0HybIxL5LJ0auu]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .cjNnN5FVTWvg48X1]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=TjD8M2iXTrf8ONOb]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=TjD8M2iXTrf8ONOb]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=TjD8M2iXTrf8ONOb]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=hUY3uLXwLGq4X1r8]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a spray of rust-laden acid in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=lkHxIonoesKdcbO4]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=lkHxIonoesKdcbO4]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=lkHxIonoesKdcbO4]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits a creature wearing nonmagical metal armor with its Bite, the armor takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed. A nonmagical metal weapon that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes the same penalty to damage rolls.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Rust bursts from metal within 60 feet: each creature wearing metal armor must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have its speed halved until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • An iron wall 30 feet long and 10 feet high rises between two points the dragon can see.
  • The dragon chooses a metal object within 60 feet that isn't being worn or carried; it crumbles to rust.
